Functionally, it is a standard connecting component in mechanical transmission systems, mainly used for circumferential fixation between shafts and hubs to transmit torque and prevent relative rotation. It is suitable for shaft-hub connections in machine tools, automobiles, and general machinery. With a simple structure and easy installation, it can withstand medium loads and is a commonly used positioning and force-transmitting element in mechanical transmission. 
Visual Features: Visually, the model is light gray overall, with a standard Woodruff key profile, featuring curved sides and a flat top with smooth edge transitions. The surface has a matte mockup texture without additional textures or details, presenting a neat and concise form.
